evidenceBoundary: The Zenodo record is a real PASCOE injection-moulding trial and exposes many cycle-specific CSVs plus trial/stage label tables with per-file MD5 checksums. The page describes the data as open access, but the specific deposited dataset licence was not rendered during review, so MouldMaster does not translate that phrase or Zenodo's default into a record-specific reuse licence. The current publisher file set is 18.7 MB; the displayed 605.2 MB Data volume is cumulative Zenodo download traffic, not source-file size. Automated raw retrieval and promotion remain blocked until exact reuse terms are captured.
